Asha R.: Free pick-up in SOMA this Thurs 6pm: Jarvis oak tabletop (48x30) — top only, the legs are water-damaged so i’m giving the top away. Also have a BenQ PD2500Q 25" color monitor (calibrated, minor bezel scuffs). Pics: https://imgur.com/desk123
Tom G.: I’d love the desk top if someone can help me move it from the curb to my car. I have a compact sedan. 
Asha R.: it’s fairly heavy but manageable for two people. happy to help coordinate.
Nina: interested in the BenQ! need it for color work. can pick up at 6:15.
Tom G.: i can bring my friend who’s good at lifting at 6pm. can you leave it by the loading bay?
Asha R.: yes loading bay is easiest. address: 65 8th St, SF. leave in bay #3 with a sticky note. gate code `7462`.
Nina: can you confirm the monitor has DP?
Asha R.: DisplayPort + HDMI. i’ll include the power cable. no calibration hardware included.
Tom G.: cool, i’ll DM you my number and ETA.
Nina: if anyone wants the monitor stand i have a spare VESA arm i can trade for a coffee. happy to trade in-person.
Asha R.: Update: Desk tabletop is reserved for Tom (first to show). BenQ reserved for Nina. If either of you cancel pls update here so others can claim. Thanks everyone :heart:
